title: Investment Document Schema
description: Schema for investment marketing documents including investment memorandums, information memorandums, teasers, management presentations, and pitch decks. Focuses on investment highlights, business overview, and opportunity assessment.

anyOf.description: Metadata describing the source document itself. Most fields here are pure metadata and do not require source quotes — they describe the document, not claims within it.

company_name.description: Name of the company being analysed in the document.

document_type_other_description.description: If document_type is 'other', describe specifically. Otherwise null.

dd_side.description: For DD documents only: whether the report was commissioned by the seller (vendor) or the acquirer (buyside). Set to 'not_applicable' for non-DD documents.

document_producer.description: Name of the firm or team that produced the document (e.g. 'PwC', 'Goldman Sachs', 'in-house strategy team').

sellside_project_name.description: Project codename used in the sale process (e.g. 'Project Falcon').

document_version.description: Version of the document if specified (e.g. 'v1', 'v2 — updated March 2025', 'Draft 3').

document_date.description: Date the document was published or finalised (YYYY-MM-DD if available).

deal_type.description: Type of transaction the document relates to.

deal_advisors_mentioned.description: Advisors named in the document (sellside/buyside M&A, legal, VDD provider, QofE provider, etc.). Capture every advisor named, including the document's own producer if applicable.

advisor_role.description: Role of the advisor in the deal.

mandate_description.description: Brief description of the advisor's mandate if specified.

deal_type.description: Type of transaction the document relates to.

mandate_description.description: Brief description of the advisor's mandate if specified.

anyOf.description: Descriptive overview of the company: what it does, where it operates, headcount, ownership, leadership, brands, and regulatory licences.

company_industry.description: Top-level industry classification. Use GICS sector naming where possible (e.g. 'Financial Services', 'Healthcare'). If not stated, value=null. Do not infer.

sub_industry.description: More specific sub-sector (e.g. 'Payments software', 'Medical devices — orthopaedics', 'HVAC distribution').

year_founded.description: Year the company was founded (as stated, e.g. '1995', 'circa 1990s').

countries_of_operation.description: Countries where the company has commercial operations.

legal_entity_structure.description: Legal entity structure of the company.

incorporation_country.description: Country of incorporation of the primary legal entity.

holding_company_name.description: Name of the ultimate holding company if applicable.

notes.description: Additional context on entity structure (e.g. multiple subsidiaries, complex group structure).

key_leadership.description: Key leadership team — CEO, CFO, Chairman, founders, board members, etc.

name.description: Name of the person in this role.

tenure_in_role.description: How long the person has held this role (e.g. '5 years', 'since 2020').

background_notes.description: Notable background, prior experience, or qualifications.

other_personnel_mentioned.description: Names and titles of other personnel mentioned in the document who don't merit a structured leadership entry (regional MDs, heads of functions, etc.).

current_owners.description: Current shareholders or owners pre-deal, with ownership % and voting rights where stated.

owner_name.description: Name of the owner (individual, fund, or entity).

ownership_pct.description: Economic ownership % as stated (preserve original formatting).

voting_rights_pct.description: Voting rights % if different from economic ownership.

notes.description: Additional context (share class, governance rights, etc.).

key_brands_or_trademarks.description: Key brands or trademarks owned by the company. Particularly important for consumer/FMCG businesses.

brand_name.description: Name of the brand or trademark.

description.description: What the brand represents or what products/services it covers.

revenue_contribution.description: Revenue contribution of this brand if stated.

notes.description: Other context (e.g. trademark registration status, brand recognition data).

regulatory_licences_held.description: Regulatory licences, certifications, or authorisations held by the company.

licence_name.description: Name of the licence (e.g. 'FCA authorisation', 'Schedule III banking licence', 'MDR Class IIa medical device certification').

date_obtained.description: Date the licence was obtained, if stated.

notes.description: Additional context (scope of permissions, conditions, etc.).

products_and_services.description: Products or services offered by the company, with ICP, pricing, and decision-maker details per item.

name.description: Name of the product or service.

description.description: What the product/service does and the problem it solves.

target_customer_archetype.description: ICP description — typical customer archetype (e.g. 'mid-market UK retailers, 50-500 employees').

typical_user.description: Person who actually uses the product day to day.

key_decision_maker.description: KDM — typical job title that approves procurement (e.g. 'Head of Finance', 'CTO').

avg_pricing.description: Average price point or price band as stated.

avg_spend_per_customer.description: Average annual spend per customer (ACV) for this product/service.

implementation_time_override.description: Optional override of company-level implementation_time, if this product has materially different dynamics.

sales_cycle_length_override.description: Optional override of company-level sales_cycle_length for this product.

total_ftes.description: Total full-time-equivalent employees (string to handle ranges like 'approx. 500-600').

fte_breakdown.description: Headcount breakdown by function and/or location.

count.description: Number of FTEs in this function.

fte_period.description: Period the FTE figures relate to (e.g. 'as of FY2024 year-end').

market_analysis.description: Market analysis: TAM/SAM/SOM, growth, structure, drivers, competitive landscape, macro exposures, sizing methodology. All values source-grounded.

tam_description.description: Definition and scope of Total Addressable Market. Capture geographies, segments, product categories, period. Include partial info rather than null.

sam_description.description: Definition and scope of Served Addressable Market — portion of TAM the company can realistically address now (product, geography, channel).

som_description.description: Definition and scope of Serviceable Obtainable Market — portion of SAM the company can realistically capture (often 3-5 year target).

tam_size_current.description: Current TAM size with currency, unit, and reference year/period.

sam_size_current.description: Current SAM size with currency, unit, and reference year/period.

som_size_current.description: Current SOM size with currency, unit, and reference year/period.

company_analysis.description: Analysis of the target company: positioning, moat, business model, customer dynamics, operational characteristics.

market_position.description: Document's description of the company's market position.

market_share_pct_of_tam.description: Company's market share as % of TAM as STATED in the document. Do not derive.

market_share_pct_of_sam.description: Company's market share as % of SAM as STATED. Do not derive.

market_share_pct_of_som.description: Company's market share as % of SOM as STATED. Do not derive.

company_moat_description.description: Free-text description of moats, especially any 'other' items.

business_model.description: Description of the company's business model — how it creates and delivers value.

customer_type.description: Customer model. B2B=sells to businesses; B2C=consumers; B2B2C=sells to a business distributing to consumers; B2B2B=sells to a business that resells/embeds into its B2B offering.

distribution_channels.description: Channels through which the company reaches customers.

implementation_time.description: Typical time from contract signature to customer being productively using the product.

sales_cycle_length.description: Typical elapsed time from first qualified opportunity to closed contract.

document_stated_operating_leverage.description: Operating leverage as characterised by the document — how marginal costs behave as the business scales.

customer_end_markets.description: End markets the company sells into, with attributes per market (automation potential, AI adoption posture, regulatory environment) as characterised in the document.

end_market_name.description: End market (e.g. 'UK retail banks', 'European mid-market manufacturers').

document_stated_automation_potential.description: How automatable workflows are in this end market AS STATED. 'high' = highly automatable; 'low' = bespoke, manual, or relationship-driven.

document_stated_ai_adoption_or_trust.description: Posture of this end market toward AI adoption and trust in AI outputs AS STATED.

document_stated_regulatory_requirements.description: Regulatory environment of this end market AS STATED.

notes.description: Additional context on this end market.

customer_concentration.description: Customer concentration RAW INPUTS. Capture stated percentages as-is — do not compute thresholds. Downstream KPI layer derives boolean flags (e.g. >10%, >40%) from these inputs.

largest_customer_pct_of_revenue.description: Largest single customer as % of revenue, as stated (e.g. 'Customer A is 12% of revenue').

top_3_combined_pct_of_revenue.description: Top 3 customers combined as % of revenue, as stated.

top_5_combined_pct_of_revenue.description: Top 5 customers combined as % of revenue, as stated.

top_10_combined_pct_of_revenue.description: Top 10 customers combined as % of revenue, as stated.

other_concentration_stat.description: Any other concentration statistic the document provides (e.g. 'top 7 customers are 65% of revenue', 'top 20 are 90%'). Capture the cohort and the %.

description.description: Free-text context on customer concentration dynamics.

customer_count.description: Total customer count as stated (e.g. '38,000 client structures', '~5,000 funds', '90% of top 30 managers').

avg_customer_relationship_tenure.description: Average customer relationship tenure as stated (e.g. '5 years', 'Top clients 5-7 years').

largest_customers.description: Top customers ranked by revenue. ONLY populate when the document provides explicit revenue attribution or ranking. Logo panels alone do not qualify — those belong in notable_customers_mentioned.

customer_name.description: Customer name (or anonymised label if redacted, e.g. 'Customer A').

relationship_tenure.description: Length of customer relationship if stated.

notable_customers_mentioned.description: Customer names referenced illustratively (logo panels, case-study mentions, brand-signal lists) WITHOUT revenue attribution or ranking. Use for prestige customer lists where the document does not quantify revenue contribution.

supplier_concentration.description: Supplier concentration RAW INPUTS. Capture stated percentages as-is — do not compute thresholds. Downstream KPI layer derives boolean flags from these.

largest_supplier_pct_of_input_cost_or_vo.description: Largest single supplier as % of input cost or volume, as stated.

top_3_combined_pct.description: Top 3 suppliers combined as % of input cost or volume.

other_concentration_stat.description: Any other supplier concentration stat (e.g. 'top 7 suppliers are 60% of inputs').

sole_source_dependencies.description: Description of any sole-source or single-source dependencies.

contract_characteristics.description: Characteristics of customer contracts: duration, renewal, pricing, protective clauses.

pct_revenue_under_contract.description: % of revenue committed under contract going forward.

typical_termination_clause.description: Typical termination terms in customer contracts.

typical_notice_period.description: Typical notice period required for termination.

price_escalator.description: Whether contracts include price escalator clauses.

mfn_clauses.description: Prevalence of Most Favoured Nation (MFN) clauses.

take_or_pay_minimum_commits.description: Prevalence of take-or-pay or minimum-commit clauses.

cancellation_friction.description: How hard it is for a customer to cancel (consumer/SMB relevance).

free_trial_or_freemium.description: Whether the company offers free trial, freemium, both, or neither.

guarantee_or_refund_policy.description: Money-back guarantee, SLA refund credits, or other refund terms if stated.

customer_churn_metrics.description: Customer churn and retention metrics AS STATED. Do not compute.

metric_type.description: Type of churn or retention metric.

cohort_definition.description: Cohort scope if specified (e.g. 'enterprise customers only').

employee_churn_metrics.description: Employee attrition and retention metrics AS STATED.

metric_type.description: Type of employee attrition or retention metric.

customer_satisfaction_metrics.description: Customer satisfaction metrics (NPS, CSAT, CES, etc.).

pricing_power_signals.description: Evidence of pricing power and willingness-to-pay.

quantified_value.description: Quantified value if available (e.g. '5% annual price increase achieved').

document_stated_evidence_strength.description: Strength of the evidence AS CHARACTERISED BY THE DOCUMENT (not a Claude judgement).

financial_profile.description: Financial profile. Capture every period available (historic + forecast). Do not compute — extract only stated values.

financial_statements.description: Structured financial statements. Capture every period available (historic and forecast). NOTE: financial statement lines are high-volume data; source quoting is NOT applied at the line-item level.

income_statement.description: Income statement line items by period.

line_item_other_label.description: If line_item is 'other', the actual label from the document.

period_label.description: Period label as stated in document (e.g. 'FY2024', 'Q1 FY2025', 'Jan 2024').

period_start_date.description: Period start date in YYYY-MM-DD if available.

period_end_date.description: Period end date in YYYY-MM-DD if available.

period_type.description: Period type: actual / budget / forecast / reforecast / ltm / proforma.

reported_or_adjusted.description: Whether the value is as reported, management-adjusted, normalised, or pro-forma.

accounting_standard.description: Accounting standard applied to this line item.

organic_or_inorganic.description: Whether the figure represents organic growth, inorganic contribution from M&A, the total combined, or is not specified.

value.description: Numerical value as stated in the document, expressed as a string to preserve original formatting.

notes.description: Any qualifying notes from the document (e.g. 'constant currency', 'excludes restructuring').

kpi_category.description: Sector or functional category of the KPI.

revenue_mix.description: Revenue mix breakdowns across multiple dimensions. NOTE: this section is high-volume data; source quoting is NOT applied at the cell level. Capture values as stated.

cac_payback_period_months.description: CAC payback period in months as stated.

gross_margin_per_customer.description: Gross margin per customer as stated.

contribution_margin_per_customer.description: Contribution margin per customer as stated.

sales_pipeline_and_bookings.description: Sales pipeline and forward bookings metrics.

total_pipeline_value.description: Total pipeline value with currency and period.

pipeline_coverage_ratio.description: Pipeline coverage ratio (pipeline / target) as stated.

growth_metrics.description: Revenue and earnings growth rates AS STATED (do not compute).

margin_profile.description: Profit margins AS STATED (do not compute).

current_trading.description: Recent performance trends and current trading status.

capital_intensity.description: Analysis of capital intensity and capex requirements.

quality_of_earnings.description: Quality of earnings assessment as stated.

growth_drivers.description: Key drivers of business growth and expansion opportunities

valuation_and_capital_structure_signals.description: Valuation and cap structure hints. Populate ONLY when the document contains explicit numbers, multiples, or cap structure language. Return null otherwise. Do not infer.

valuation_hints.description: Valuation-related signals extracted from the document.

context.description: Description of how the hint is presented.
Description of how the hint is presented.

returns_drivers.description: Drivers of investment returns mentioned (growth, margin expansion, multiple expansion, operational improvements).

exit_valuation_assumptions.description: Exit valuation assumptions or scenarios mentioned.

merger_considerations.description: Merger-specific analysis. Only populate if deal_type == 'merger'. Return null otherwise.

industrial_rationale.description: Strategic logic for combining the two entities.

sources_of_synergies.description: Itemised synergies expected from the merger.

total_runrate_synergy_by_exit.description: Total run-rate synergies expected by exit.

synergy_metric.description: Metric the synergy is measured against.

target_year.description: Year by which run-rate is achieved.

carveout_considerations.description: Carve-out specific considerations. Only populate if deal_type == 'carve_out'. Return null otherwise.

scope_of_carveout.description: Description of which business unit, division, or assets are being carved out.

tsa_arrangements.description: Transitional Service Agreements (TSAs) — services parent will provide post-close, duration, exit plan.

stranded_costs.description: Stranded costs left in parent or transferred — quantified if available.

standalone_cost_buildup.description: Costs to establish standalone capabilities (IT, HR, finance, real estate).

carve_out_perimeter_risks.description: Risks around the perimeter — assets/liabilities/contracts that may or may not transfer.

customer_contract_transferability.description: Whether customer contracts can transfer without consent / change of control issues.

employee_transfer_implications.description: Employee transfer implications (TUPE in UK/EU, equivalents elsewhere).

regulatory_approvals_required.description: Regulatory approvals required to complete the carve-out.
